interpretation.possible_value: CPU wait for unrelated work would support a shared scheduling-delay explanation for that new window. Low or missing wait would leave transient historical contention and query-specific delay unresolved.
forbidden_claims: Historical cause isolated to a named workload
Wall-time percentage from thread aggregate counters
Safe window from idle state or one capacity snapshot

hypotheses.statement: Scheduling delay affects unrelated small work during a recorded current resource window.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: A terminal exact-query profile with observed CPU wait on the synthetic control supports this contributor in the new window, without identifying a competing service.

hypotheses.statement: Execution features of the failed benchmark query caused most of its delay.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: A fast synthetic control does not establish this cause because it lacks the failed query features; slow unrelated work weakens an exclusively query-specific explanation for that new window.

hypotheses.statement: Historical shared contention has ceased or changed.
hypotheses.distinguishing_observation: Current normal/low-wait control is compatible with this and query-specific delay; a single new control cannot distinguish them.
